title: Transformation Decision Record — frontmatter
description: Schema for the YAML frontmatter of a Transformation Decision Record (TDR), per spec.md §4.1. It validates the machine-readable fields only; the markdown body is human judgement and is deliberately not schema-constrained. Adopter-specific fields are permitted under the `x-` namespace (spec §4.3) — the standard defines no vocabulary for them. See TDR-0006, TDR-0015.

^x-.description: Adopter extension namespace. Name extensions `x-<owner>-<field>` to avoid collision. The standard defines no meaning for these fields, no expectation of portability, and schema validity implies nothing about security — a record may validate while carrying a classification nothing enforces. Anything broadly useful should be proposed for the core by superseding TDR (spec §4.3, TDR-0015).

id.description: TDR-nnnn, unique within the owning organisation or repository.

conforms_to.description: Durable binding to the specification this record is presented as conforming to, as `mtdr/<package>/<record>@<version>`. OPTIONAL in the schema so that every record authored before it existed still validates; the MTDR repository requires it of its own governed records and tests/verify.py enforces that. It is what lets a DETACHED record -- one file, with no repository around it -- identify its record type and resolve the specification and schema that govern it, without repository-private interpretation (DAC-0032 constraint 2, TDR-0043).

title.description: Imperative or declarative statement of the decision.

decision_date.description: ISO 8601 date, YYYY-MM-DD. Frontmatter is validated as JSON: a YAML parser may load an unquoted date as a native date type, so normalise it to an ISO-8601 string before validation.

accountable_owner.description: A named individual — not a committee.

confidence.description: The owner's stated confidence at decision time. Required for full and minimal templates.

confirmed_by_outcome.description: `pending — <review trigger>`, a date plus evidence reference, or `none`. Required for full and minimal templates.

tdrRefList.description: One or more TDR ids (comma-separated), or the literal `none`.
